title: Chapter 186
text:
Han Xiao gave the patrol officer a sleeping pill and hid it in a trash can in the alley. He would probably only be found the next morning.

The sleeping pill was not a normal product on the market but a secret formula created by Golden Fox. According to her description, it could make a three-meter-tall short-haired elephant fall asleep in ten seconds. As for why Golden Fox used an elephant as an experiment, Han Xiao was also puzzled.

Golden Fox took the initiative to provide the sleeping pill as a gesture of goodwill, but Han Xiao felt that the atmosphere between him and Golden Fox was very strange. When their eyes met, it was as if a spark had been ignited. Golden Fox was like a frightened little animal, and she quickly looked away, not daring to look at Han Xiao.

If it wasn't for the fact that he had left a bad first impression on the Golden Fox back then, he would have thought that the Golden Fox was interested in him. In fact, she was just afraid of him.

Han Xiao diluted the potion, and the effect was not that strong. Normal people would wake up after about ten hours of sleep. He tried it himself, and it said that one would be immune to it as long as one's Endurance was above 45. Han Xiao's Endurance was now close to 90.

The average Endurance of a LV 55 Mechanic was around 70. Han Xiao's Endurance was not much higher than the average, but his HP was more than half that of a Mechanic of the same level!

With the bonus from [Elementary Strengthened Life] and [Extraordinary Physique], Han Xiao's HP was around 3,400. Combined with the Magnetically-Controlled Retractable Armor and Viper, which were unique to the Mechanic class, he was already at the level of a Boss of the same level.

However, Han Xiao decided to use the traditional method of infiltration this time. After all, this was the capital of Maple, and he was afraid that he would be in trouble if he went too far. He had no choice but to temporarily abandon Master Kang and Master Ai's Path of Invincibility and become Bald Head 47.

Wearing a police uniform, Han Xiao swaggered to his first target, Miller Senning's villa. Beside the road, there were trees and flowerbeds. The shadows of the trees danced in the wind, and the light from the street lamps was cut into small light curtains by the swaying branches, creating mottled shadows.

Using the Night Stalker skill, Han Xiao entered the [Stealth] state and walked around the villa, observing the cameras on the streets.

"There are a total of three cameras monitoring the villa from three directions. They will automatically turn and move at the same speed … Eh, it seems to form a blind spot. Hmm … the duration is very short."

Han Xiao had discovered an opportunity, but this was not indicated in the report. It was unknown whether Ghost Blade had not discovered it or had deliberately not written it.

"If you want to sneak in, you have to solve the problem of the cameras first." Every five minutes, there would be a two-second blind spot in the intersecting surveillance field of vision. This made things much simpler. There was no need to go through so much trouble to dismantle the wires of the cameras and invade the surveillance network. As long as they were fast enough and jumped into the villa, they could avoid being discovered by the surveillance cameras, or rather, prolong the time they would be discovered.

This was because the entire city's surveillance system was not monitored 24 hours a day. If a "patrol officer" suddenly disappeared from the surveillance system, it would not be immediately discovered unless it was coincidentally seen by the person monitoring it.

He didn't ask for a perfect infiltration without leaving any clues. All he wanted was to get through the night and complete the mission smoothly.

There were secret service members guarding the villa both inside and outside the villa. There were verification devices at the entrance and exit, and there were electric railings on the walls. Other than that, everything was no different from a normal house. The secret service members outside were easy to deal with as long as they were distracted. However, there were also people guarding the villa, so it was impossible to pinpoint the location with the naked eye.

Han Xiao had an idea. He took out a pair of sunglasses and put them on. They looked like normal sunglasses, but they were a portable version that used electromagnetic scanning. He pressed a small switch on the leg of the glasses, and he could see through the walls to see the biological signs inside the villa. He could see blurry human figures, which was enough to pinpoint the location.

However, it was weird to wear sunglasses at night. It reminded him of the song "Broken Intestines" in Kung Fu Hustle.

The officials of Maple were protected 24 hours a day, as if they were afraid of being attacked on the streets. It was not hard to imagine how unpopular they were. The other five nations did not have such measures, so the air in Maple was filled with pressure.

The situation of each nation was different, and the protection of the officials in Maple was not something that had existed since the beginning. It was similar to when the government established the policy of evicting the lower-class citizens in the capital. It came from an incident that was well-known in Maple but kept a secret — the "Ulric Incident". It happened in the eleventh year of the new era of the Six Nations. Han Xiao had seen this history on the timeline of events on the Dark Net.

There were many places in the history of each civilization in Galaxy that could be dug deeper. As for Maple, whether it was in his previous life or now, Han Xiao did not have a deep understanding of it. Since he was in the middle of the mission, these thoughts only flashed through his mind. He continued to think about how to infiltrate the villa.

The Secret Service members patrolled around the villa with a warning look. Han Xiao threw down a Spider Detector and observed from a hidden corner. It was not convenient for him to pass by the villa too many times, as it would only alert the guards.

Soon, he found an opportunity. Taking advantage of the moment when the cameras and the Secret Service personnel were in a blind spot, he activated his Electromagnetic Hover-boots and quietly slid over the wall. He targeted a tree in the manor and landed behind it. His movements were smooth and fluid.

Although he tried to control his strength, the leaves still shook slightly. There was a Secret Service member hiding under the tree. He was very alert when he felt the vibration and immediately looked up.

Han Xiao had a plan when he jumped in, so he did not stop. When the Secret Service member squinted and observed carefully, his over one hundred points of Dexterity made him as fast as a ghost. He walked out from behind the tree and covered the Secret Service member's mouth. He dragged the Secret Service member behind the tree and injected him with a syringe. The Secret Service member was quiet before he even started to struggle.

The sound was not loud, but there was still a Secret Service member standing guard not far away. He saw his partner leave his post from the corner of his eye, but he did not see Han Xiao's ghost-like speed clearly.

"Siri?" The Secret Service member called his partner's name in a low voice and walked over.

"Not good." Han Xiao knew this was bad. Traditional infiltration was about timing, which made him nervous all the time. He changed his mind and immediately had a solution. He quickly scanned the face of the Secret Service member he had knocked out and changed his face. He showed his head from behind the tree and shook his head to show that he was okay.

"What are you doing behind the tree?" The Secret Service member saw his partner's face and relaxed slightly. He continued to approach, wanting to go around the tree to see what was going on.

Han Xiao turned his palm and a small pistol appeared. He quietly shot the syringe and hit the Secret Service member's neck. The Secret Service member staggered and was about to fall asleep. Han Xiao hurriedly moved to support him and carefully dragged him behind the tree.

There were four sentry posts in the villa, and they all had walkie-talkies to communicate with each other. It would not take a few seconds for the others to realize that two of their partners were missing.

"I can only knock out all the sentry posts." The Secret Service members outside and inside the villa were different teams. They would only talk to each other once in a while to confirm the situation. This way, he could delay them for half an hour to an hour. He felt that there was enough time for him to act.

Han Xiao moved quickly and stealthily like a cat. The remaining two sentry posts were quickly knocked out by him. They were just well-trained elites and could not resist at all.

After confirming that the eyes were removed, Han Xiao jumped into the villa through the window and turned on the electromagnetic scanning glasses. The structure of the villa was in full view. The bald official was sleeping in the master bedroom with his young and beautiful wife. There was also a housekeeper sleeping in another room. There were only three people in the huge house.

Han Xiao groped his way to the study. He took out the evidence files collected by the Dark Net and placed them in a conspicuous place on the table. That was one of his goals.

"There is no time to lose. I still have some time before Maple discovers that someone has infiltrated. I have to hurry." Han Xiao slipped out of the villa at the right time. The Secret Service members standing guard outside were still doing their duty and did not know what was going on inside.

Then, Han Xiao ran to the mansions of three more targets. The security environment was different. With Level 55 Perception, the intelligence provided by Golden Fox and Ghost Blade, as well as equipment such as the Face Simulator and the Hover-boots, the operation was daunting but not dangerous.

When it came to the third target, there was a small accident. While Han Xiao was putting away the documents in the study, the target woke up shakily and wanted to walk past the study. Han Xiao hurriedly hid behind the floor lamp in the corner.

If one did not look closely, it was easy to mistake a floor lamp for a human figure, and people would subconsciously ignore it. This was a bold hiding spot, and Han Xiao felt that this quick thinking was very good. Unfortunately, the ending was completely different from what he had expected.

Can you imagine waking up in the middle of the night to go to the toilet, walking in the dark corridor with panic? Passing by the study and mistaking the floor lamp for a human, you would be even more nervous. Just as you were about to take a closer look and comfort yourself that you were just scaring yourself, you realized that there was really an uninvited guest standing behind the lamp!

The target was an old man. He clutched his chest and fell straight down.

You have killed Dark Van Vansitti (Level 5). You have received 1 EXP.

The target was actually scared to death … scared to death … dead …

"F * ck! How is that possible? "Han Xiao was dumbfounded.

I did not want to kill anyone! You're suffering from a heart attack! I'm innocent!

"Hey, old man, wake up. You still have a lot of youth. How can you die like this?" Han Xiao grabbed the old man's shoulder and shook him, almost breaking the old man's bones.

I accidentally killed the mission target. What should I do?

Han Xiao had a headache.

Suddenly, he had a flash of inspiration. He had a new idea.

"Wait a minute, the main purpose of this mission is to reduce the number of officials who are against funding. If all of them die, no one will object."

…

"Achoo!"

Bennett, who was far away in the Southern Continent, sneezed and suddenly had a bad feeling.
